verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's documented database branching gives you isolated development and testing environments separate from production. Postgres branches are 'isolated database deployments' for dev/test (docs-10, docs-32), and Vitess branches the schema like code (docs-9). Agents and scripts can drive this through the CLI, which creates and lists branches and runs non-interactive SQL (docs-41, docs-17); branches can also be restored to a point in time (docs-5), and a community user corroborates branch-per-Git-branch workflows (comm-9). Missing for 10: documented guardrails that keep agents/MCP or service tokens scoped to non-production branches, and clarity on seeding realistic test data into a sandbox branch without copying production data.
